propositions: A live Gerrit webhook-to-bot probe is required to validate end-to-end project criterion execution through the deployed four-pass review pipeline, not offline fixtures alone.

The positive-control patchset establishes that a valid Pass-1 discovery refinement (isolating operative clause and naming instructed/owning phases) produces no project-criterion finding when the criterion is correctly deployed.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], and observable Pass-2 validity/impact and Pass-3 priority/decision/threshold attributes.
Blocking must remain disabled (blocking_enabled: false, block_threshold: 0.90) throughout the probe; blocking promotion is deferred to a future data-backed posture ticket.
The final cleaned patchset (PS4) removes all invalid directives, lands to main with only phase-compliant instructions, and produces no project criterion finding on the committed revision.
